_A_CALENDAR_COMPONENT_DESCRIPTION_: The ACalendar component shows a month, a week or a day with events, like Outlook. Events can last several days and have a color. The names of the months and weekdays come from the current language. The component does not create events: open your own form on the events day-click and time-click.
_A_CALENDAR_BASIC_DESCRIPTION_: events is an array of objects with label, start and end. v-model is the selected day as "YYYY-MM-DD". The arrow keys move between the days, Page Up and Page Down change the month.
_A_CALENDAR_MULTI_DAY_DESCRIPTION_: An event from start to end is a bar over several days and continues in the next week or month. end is the last day of the event. color is a color of the theme (primary, secondary, tertiary, success, info, warning, danger, gray) or any CSS color. Events with isAllDay have no time. max-events-per-day="0" shows all events.
_A_CALENDAR_REC_DESCRIPTION_: recurrence makes an event a series: { frequency, interval, weekdays, until, count, exceptions }. frequency is daily, weekly, monthly or yearly, interval repeats every n-th time, weekdays (0 is Sunday) sets the days of a weekly series. A series ends with until (the last day) or after count occurrences, exceptions are skipped days. The occurrences have the sign ↻. event-click, event-drop and event-resize get the item of the series and occurrence: the parent decides whether the series or only this occurrence changes.
_A_CALENDAR_WEEK_DESCRIPTION_: view="week" shows a week with the hours, the buttons Month, Week and Day switch the view (v-model:view). Events with a time lie in the time grid, overlapping events share the width of the day. All-day events and events over several days are bars above the hours. hourStart and hourEnd limit the hours, scrollToHour is the hour visible at the top.
_A_CALENDAR_DAY_DESCRIPTION_: view="day" shows one day with the hours, like the week view. The buttons change the day, the arrow keys too. views sets the views of the switch, here only Day and Week.
_A_CALENDAR_DRAG_DESCRIPTION_: With isDraggable events can be dragged. In the month and in the all-day row an event moves to another day and keeps its time, in the time grid it gets the day and the time of the place (rounded to timeStep). With isResizable the edges of an event change its start and its end: the top and the bottom edge in the time grid, the start and the end edge of a bar in the month and in the all-day row. The calendar does not change the events: it emits event-drop and event-resize with the new start and end, the parent saves them. A function locks single events, here the birthday. Dragging needs a pointer: for the keyboard offer a form, like in the example "Creating events".
_A_CALENDAR_EXPORT_DESCRIPTION_: getIcs() returns the events as an iCalendar file (.ics), downloadIcs({ fileName }) downloads it. The file opens in Outlook, Google Calendar and Apple Calendar. All events are exported, not only the shown days: single events in UTC, a series in the local time (it keeps its hour in summer time) as RRULE with EXDATE. Without the component the function getCalendarIcs({ events }) makes the same file, e.g. on a server.
_A_CALENDAR_IMPORT_DESCRIPTION_: parseCalendarIcs(text) reads an .ics file into events of the calendar: { events, skipped, warnings }. The calendar does not save them: show them, let the user confirm and save them on the server. Times in UTC and with TZID become the local time, RRULE and EXDATE become recurrence, a changed occurrence (RECURRENCE-ID) becomes a single event and an exception of its series, DESCRIPTION and LOCATION are kept. What the calendar cannot show is reported: a rule like "the second Tuesday" (the event is imported once) or an unknown time zone (the local time is used). Cancelled events are skipped.
_A_CALENDAR_IMPORT_CODE_RRULE_NOT_SUPPOR: "{{label}}": the rule {{value}} cannot be shown, the event is imported once.
_A_CALENDAR_IMPORT_CODE_TIME_ZONE_UNKNOW: "{{label}}": the time zone "{{value}}" is unknown, the local time is used.
_A_CALENDAR_MAX_EVENTS_DESCRIPTION_: maxEventsPerDay limits the events shown in a day (3 by default). The others are counted in a button +N, which emits the event more-click with all events of the day.
_A_CALENDAR_SLOTS_DESCRIPTION_: The slot header replaces the title and the buttons, day the day number and event the content of an event.
_A_CALENDAR_CREATE_DESCRIPTION_: The form is not part of the component. Here a click on a day opens AModalForm to create an event, in the week and the day view a click on a time opens it with this time (time-click). Repeat makes the event a series. A click on an event opens it (an occurrence opens the series) for editing or deleting. The button Delete is added with the slot modalFooterAppend.
_A_CALENDAR_CREATE_DELETE_CONFIRM_BODY_{: Do you want to delete the event {{label}}?
_A_CALENDAR_PROPS_COLOR_DEFAULT_: The color of events without a color.
_A_CALENDAR_PROPS_EVENTS_: The events. An event without a valid start is ignored.
_A_CALENDAR_PROPS_FIRST_DAY_OF_WEEK_: The first day of the week: 0 is Sunday, 1 is Monday. The default comes from ADatepickerPlugin.
_A_CALENDAR_PROPS_HOUR_END_: Week and day view: the hour where the time grid ends (1 to 24).
_A_CALENDAR_PROPS_HOUR_START_: Week and day view: the hour where the time grid starts (0 to 23).
_A_CALENDAR_PROPS_ID_: The id of the component. The title has the id {id}_title.
_A_CALENDAR_PROPS_IS_DRAGGABLE_: Whether the events can be dragged. A function gets the event and returns true or false.
_A_CALENDAR_PROPS_IS_RESIZABLE_: Whether the start and the end of the events can be changed by pulling their edges. A function gets the event and returns true or false.
_A_CALENDAR_PROPS_KEY_COLOR_: The key (or a function) of the color of an event.
_A_CALENDAR_PROPS_KEY_END_: The key (or a function) of the end of an event. The end is the last day of the event. Without an end the event lasts one day.
_A_CALENDAR_PROPS_KEY_ID_: The key (or a function) of the id of an event.
_A_CALENDAR_PROPS_KEY_IS_ALL_DAY_: The key (or a function) for events without a time.
_A_CALENDAR_PROPS_KEY_LABEL_: The key (or a function) of the title of an event.
_A_CALENDAR_PROPS_KEY_RECURRENCE_: The key (or a function) of the rule of a recurring event: { frequency, interval, weekdays, until, count, exceptions }.
_A_CALENDAR_PROPS_KEY_START_: The key (or a function) of the start of an event: a Date, a timestamp or a string like "2026-03-10" or "2026-03-10T09:00:00".
_A_CALENDAR_PROPS_MAX_EVENTS_PER_DAY_: The maximum number of events shown in a day. 0 shows all events.
_A_CALENDAR_PROPS_MODEL_VALUE_: The selected day. The calendar shows its month, week or day.
_A_CALENDAR_PROPS_SCROLL_TO_HOUR_: Week and day view: the hour visible at the top of the time grid.
_A_CALENDAR_PROPS_TIME_STEP_: Week and day view: the minutes to which the start of time-click is rounded.
_A_CALENDAR_PROPS_VIEWS_: The views of the switch in the header. With one view the switch is hidden.
_A_CALENDAR_EVENTS_DAY_CLICK_: A click on a day: { date, events, $event }.
_A_CALENDAR_EVENTS_EVENT_CLICK_: A click on an event: { event, start, end, occurrence, $event }. occurrence (only for a series): { date, start, end } of the clicked occurrence.
_A_CALENDAR_EVENTS_EVENT_DROP_: An event was dropped at another place: { event, start, end, occurrence, $event }. The duration stays the same.
_A_CALENDAR_EVENTS_EVENT_RESIZE_: The start or the end of an event was changed by pulling its edge: { event, start, end, occurrence, $event }.
_A_CALENDAR_EVENTS_RANGE_CHANGE_: The shown days have changed (also when the calendar is mounted): { start, end, month, view }. Load the events of these days here.
_A_CALENDAR_EVENTS_TIME_CLICK_: Week and day view, a click on an empty place of the time grid: { date, start, end, $event }. end is start plus timeStep.
_A_CALENDAR_SLOT_DAY_: The content of a day: { day, events }.
_A_CALENDAR_SLOT_EVENT_: The content of an event: { event, start, end, isStart, isEnd, isRecurring }. isStart and isEnd are false if the bar continues in another week.
_A_CALENDAR_SLOT_HEADER_: The header: { title, range, view, views, changeView, goToPrevious, goToNext, goToToday }.
_A_CALENDAR_EXPOSES_DOWNLOAD_ICS_: Downloads the events as an .ics file: { fileName = "calendar.ics", calendarName, uidDomain }.
_A_CALENDAR_EXPOSES_FOCUS_DAY_: Focuses a day ("YYYY-MM-DD") and shows its month.
_A_CALENDAR_EXPOSES_GET_ICS_: Returns the events as the text of an .ics file: { calendarName, uidDomain }. The UID of an event is id@uidDomain (default "aloha-vue").
_A_CALENDAR_EXPOSES_GO_TO_DATE_: Shows the month of a date.
_A_CALENDAR_EXPOSES_GO_TO_NEXT_: Shows the next month, week or day.
_A_CALENDAR_EXPOSES_GO_TO_NEXT_MONTH_: The same as goToNext (the name of the first version).
_A_CALENDAR_EXPOSES_GO_TO_PREVIOUS_: Shows the previous month, week or day.
_A_CALENDAR_EXPOSES_GO_TO_PREVIOUS_MONTH: The same as goToPrevious (the name of the first version).
